US and Iran Agree to Talks Amid Hormuz Tensions

The United States and Iran have reportedly agreed to hold talks in Doha on June 30 to address ongoing tensions, particularly concerning the Strait of Hormuz. While some reports indicate an agreement to "stand down" and halt attacks, others suggest continued escalations and retaliatory actions. The discussions are expected to cover various aspects of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), with a focus on de-escalating the regional crisis.
